You can create a js script in tampermonkey or similar, so that it executes when you visit voat.co

It seems that the div with id "container" has a max-width of 1200px, removing that should fix the problem you're having

edit: here's a quick Tampermonkey script that makes voat "fullscreen":

// ==UserScript==
// @name Voat fullscreen
// @namespace http://use.i.E.your.homepage/
// @version 0.1
// @description enter something useful
// @match https://voat.co/*
// @copyright 2015+, You
// ==/UserScript==

document.getElementById("container").style.maxWidth = "none";
